xna-type.name: ResourceContentManager
xna-type.summary: Subclass of ContentManager which is specialized to read from .resx resource files, rather than directly from individual files on disk.

constructor.summary: Creates a new instance of ResourceContentManager.

parameters.parameter: The service provider the ContentManager should use to locate services.
The resource manager for the ResourceContentManager to read from.

method.name: OpenStream
method.summary: Opens a stream for reading the specified resource. Derived classes can replace this to implement pack files or asset compression.

overload.summary: Opens a stream for reading the specified resource. Derived classes can replace this to implement pack files or asset compression.

parameters.parameter: The name of the asset being read.
